root.name: Ponziani Opening: Romanishin Variation
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. c3 Be7

overview: Black defends the e5 pawn with 3...Be7, keeping flexible instead of playing 3...d5 or 3...Nf6. White usually plays d4 and gets a good centre, with Black relying on solid development and ...d6. The game is a normal Open Game with a slight White space edge and little forcing theory.

white_ideas.idea: Develop with Bb5 or Be2 and castle

typical_structures.structure: White pawns on c3 and d4 against Black's e5/d6 chain

structure.notes: The centre tension on e5/d4 is unresolved.

approach.notes: The Ponziani is a respectable if uncommon choice.

level.notes: Plans are clear and theory is light.

plan_phrases: build a pawn centre with d4
